title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder with Glass Shelf, Wall Mount Solid Brass – Waverly Place Collection Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bath storage with a covered toilet paper holder that adds a convenient glass shelf above the roll while saving space with a wall-mounted design.

  • Covered design: helps protect tissue from moisture and dust
  • Glass shelf: a handy spot to keep small items dry
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Clean install: concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Coordinated look: part of the Waverly Place Collection for matching Waverly Place and grooved bathroom hardware styling

Specs
Collection: Waverly Place
Style: Traditional
Material: Brass
Mounting: Wall mount
Dimensions: 8.75 in (L) x 6 in (W) x 4.6 in (H); projection 6 in
Product weight: 5.6 lb
Assembly required: No
Included: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finish options
Available in a wide variety of designer finishes (28 options), including statement colors such as sea foam green, glokzin teal, fire engine red, mediterranean blue, and pink.
